fullDescription: A dark, warm-charcoal SaaS pricing page with an amber accent and a live per-seat calculator: a monthly/annual toggle plus a seat stepper recompute every tier price and team total across a 3-card grid.

structured.summary: A frameless, fully responsive dark SaaS pricing page for a dev-tool / AI design product, built around a per-seat model: a warm charcoal background washed with amber radial glows, a sticky blurred nav, a centered hero, an interactive control bar (monthly/annual toggle + a seat stepper) that live-recalculates a 3-tier card grid (Starter / Studio-highlighted / Scale), each card showing per-seat price plus a computed team total, followed by a testimonial strip, an accordion FAQ, a gradient CTA panel, and a slim footer. The signature is the amber-on-charcoal palette, Sora/Inter type pairing, and a pricing structure where one billing toggle and one seat stepper drive every price on the page.

style.description: Warm, premium dark mode: near-black warm charcoals (brown-tinted, not blue-black) lit by soft amber/honey radial gradients in the upper corners, with amber as the single accent used for the CTA, the highlighted plan, checkmarks, and small honey-colored value figures. Sora (geometric, heavy-weight) for display/numbers, Inter for body. Generous rounding (rounded-2xl/3xl), subtle 1px white/8 borders, soft amber glow on the featured card, and a faint film-grain-style radial overlay. Restrained, confident, dev-tool feel.
style.prompt: Dark, warm-charcoal pricing page with a single amber accent. Exact palette: page/base background #0d0c0a (charcoal-950); surface layers #15130f (900), #1b1814 (850), #221e18 (800), #2c271f (700), #3a342a (600); accent amber #f0a830 (DEFAULT) with #f5c25e (soft, hover), #d98b16 (deep, gradient end) and #ffd98a (honey, used for highlighted price totals and small value text). Body text is warm stone (Tailwind stone-300/400/500); headings and prices are pure white. Borders are white at ~8% opacity (border-white/8); dividers white/8. Apply two amber radial-gradient glows on the main content: radial-gradient(900px 520px at 80% -12%, rgba(240,168,48,0.16), transparent 60%) and radial-gradient(720px 460px at 0% 2%, rgba(240,168,48,0.07), transparent 55%). Featured card gets an amber glow ring: box-shadow 0 0 0 1px rgba(240,168,48,0.45), 0 26px 64px -22px rgba(240,168,48,0.40). Standard cards get a soft drop shadow 0 18px 50px -28px rgba(0,0,0,0.8). Fonts: 'Sora' (weights 400-800) for display/headings/prices/numbers via font-display; 'Inter' (400-600) for body via font-sans; antialiased. Rounding: nav pills and buttons rounded-full, cards rounded-2xl, CTA panel rounded-3xl. Text selection highlight uses rgba(240,168,48,0.30). Smooth scroll. Icons are thin Phosphor-style line/duotone glyphs in amber or white.

layout_and_structure.description: A single-column, centered, max-w-7xl frameless responsive web page stacked vertically: sticky blurred nav, centered hero with pill badge + headline + subcopy, an interactive control bar (billing toggle + seat stepper), a 3-column pricing card grid that reflows to 2 then 1 column, an annual-savings note line, a 3-up testimonial strip, a centered accordion FAQ, a gradient CTA panel, and a footer row. All content is centered within mx-auto max-w-7xl (FAQ narrows to max-w-3xl); horizontal padding px-5 on mobile, px-8 on desktop. Pricing cards are grid-cols-1 -> md:grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-3.

prompts.prompt: Sticky top nav (sticky top-0 z-50) with a translucent charcoal-950/80 background and a backdrop blur (backdrop-filter: saturate(160%) blur(14px)), and a 1px bottom border in white/5. Inside, an mx-auto max-w-7xl, h-16 flex row, space-between: left = brand lockup (an 8x8 rounded-lg gradient square from amber to amber-deep holding a small sparkle/magic glyph in charcoal, next to the wordmark 'Promptsmith' in Sora 700 white); center (hidden on mobile, md:flex) = nav links Library / Canvas / Pricing (active, white) / FAQ in stone-400 with hover:white; right = a text 'Log in' link plus a 'Start free' pill button (rounded-full, bg-amber, charcoal-950 text, amber glow shadow, hover bg-amber-soft).

Centered hero (max-w-7xl, generous top padding pt-14 -> sm:pt-24). Top: a small rounded-full pill badge with amber/25 border on amber/10 fill, a users glyph, and honey-colored text 'Pay per designer, scale with the team'. Below it a large balanced display headline in Sora 800, white, leading-[1.05], 'Pricing that grows one seat at a time' (text-4xl -> sm:text-6xl, with a line break before 'one seat at a time' on desktop). Then a max-w-xl stone-400 subhead: 'Every plan ships the full prompt library and infinite canvas. Add seats as your team ships more UI, and save when you go annual.'

prompts.part: Control bar (billing toggle + seat stepper) — the interactive pricing engine
prompts.partPt: Control bar (billing toggle + seat stepper) — the interactive Planos e Preços engine
prompts.prompt: A centered max-w-2xl rounded-2xl control bar (border white/8, bg charcoal-850/70, padding ~p-3) that stacks vertically on mobile and goes horizontal on sm with a thin vertical divider between the two controls. LEFT control = a segmented billing toggle: a rounded-full charcoal-950/70 track holding two pills, 'Monthly' and 'Annual'; the active pill is solid amber with charcoal-950 text, inactive is stone-400; the Annual pill also carries a small 'SAVE 20%' badge (rounded-full charcoal-950 chip, honey text). RIGHT control = a seat stepper: label 'Seats', then a rounded-full bordered group with a minus button (subtle white/6 fill, hover white/12), a bold tabular-nums seat count in the middle (Sora 700, white, default 3), and a plus button filled solid amber (charcoal-950 glyph). Buttons get a quick scale(0.92) press animation. JS: changing the toggle or stepper live-updates every per-seat price AND every computed team total on the cards, and recomputes the annual-savings figure; seats clamp 1-99.

prompts.part: Pricing card grid (3 tiers, middle highlighted)
prompts.partPt: Planos e Preços card grid (3 tiers, middle highlighted)
prompts.prompt: A responsive pricing grid (grid-cols-1 -> md:grid-cols-2 -> lg:grid-cols-3, gap-5) of three flex-col cards, each rounded-2xl p-7. Card head: tier name in Sora 700 white on the left, a rounded-xl icon chip on the right (amber/10 fill + amber/20 border + honey glyph for standard tiers; solid amber chip with charcoal glyph for the featured tier). Price block: a big Sora 800 price (text-5xl) with a small superscript '$' and a two-line '/ seat per month' label in stone; each price element carries data-monthly and data-annual values so the toggle can swap them. Below the price, a small computed line 'TOTAL / mo for N seats' where TOTAL is honey-colored and recalculated live (price x seats). Then a one-line tier description, a full-width CTA button, and a checklist (each item a small amber check glyph + stone text). TIERS: (1) Starter — $12 monthly / $9 annual per seat, 'For solo builders and small squads getting their first designs out the door', outline/ghost button 'Start free trial', features: Full prompt library access / 300 generations per seat per mo / 3 infinite canvases / PNG & HTML export / Community support. (2) Studio — HIGHLIGHTED: amber/40 border, subtle vertical gradient charcoal-800->850, the amber glow ring shadow, a top amber gradient hairline, and a centered '-top-3' floating 'MOST POPULAR' amber pill; price $29 monthly / $23 annual per seat, 'For product teams shipping real UI weekly with the coding-agent skill', solid amber button 'Choose Studio', features: Everything in Starter / Unlimited generations / Unlimited canvases / Coding-agent skill (Claude Code / Cursor) / Shared team workspace / Priority support. (3) Scale — $59 monthly / $47 annual per seat, 'For larger orgs that need governance, SSO, and a design system source of truth', outline button 'Talk to sales', features: Everything in Studio / SSO & SCIM provisioning / Shared design-system tokens / Audit log & roles / Dedicated success manager. Under the grid, a centered savings note line with a small amber tag glyph: 'You're saving $X a year on the Studio plan with annual billing' (X recomputed live as (monthly-annual) x 12 x seats); the whole note dims to ~45% opacity when Monthly is selected.

A 3-up row (grid-cols-1 -> sm:grid-cols-3, gap-3) of compact testimonial chips, each a rounded-xl card (border white/6, bg charcoal-850/50, px-4 py-3.5) with a small round amber/15 monogram avatar (initials in amber, Sora 700) beside a short single-line quote in stone-300, e.g. 'Shipped a full onboarding flow before lunch. Wild.', 'The per-seat pricing just makes sense for our squad.', 'The library alone is worth the subscription.'

A narrower section (max-w-3xl) with a centered Sora 800 heading 'Questions, answered' and a stone-400 subhead 'Everything about seats, billing, and the library.' Below, a single rounded-2xl container (border white/8, bg charcoal-850/50) with divide-y white/8 holding native <details> accordion rows; each summary is a flex space-between row with a white 600 question and an amber plus glyph that rotates 45deg to an x when open (group-open:rotate-45); answer text is stone-400. First row open by default. Questions: 'How does per-seat billing work?', 'What counts as a generation?', 'Can I use the coding-agent skill on any plan?', 'Do you offer a free trial?'.

prompts.partPt: Chamada Final para Ação panel + Rodapé
prompts.prompt: CTA: a full-width rounded-3xl panel (border amber/20, gradient bg charcoal-800 -> charcoal-900, padding sm:p-12, centered) with a Sora 800 headline 'Design your next screen in the next five minutes', a stone-400 subline 'Start free, add seats when the team is ready. No card, no lock-in.', and a rounded-full amber pill button 'Start free' with a trailing arrow glyph and amber glow. FOOTER: a top border (white/6) on charcoal-950, mx-auto max-w-7xl row that stacks on mobile and goes space-between on sm: left = mini brand lockup (small amber gradient square + 'Promptsmith'), center = muted copyright 'c 2026 Promptsmith. Designed at the speed of prompt.', right = three social glyphs (X, Discord, Patreon-style) in stone-500 with hover:amber.

special_ui_components.description: The defining interaction: one billing toggle (Monthly/Annual) plus one seat stepper drive every number on the page in real time, so visitors immediately see what their actual team will pay.
special_ui_components.prompt: Store two pieces of state: annual (bool) and seats (int, default 3, clamp 1-99). Each price element holds data-monthly and data-annual attributes. On any change, for every card: set the displayed per-seat price to the monthly or annual value, then set that card's 'TOTAL / mo for N seats' line to (per-seat price x seats), formatted with a leading $ and thousands separators; update all seat-count labels to N; recompute the global savings figure as (studioMonthly - studioAnnual) x 12 x seats and write it into the savings note; and dim the savings note to ~45% opacity when Monthly is active. Wire minus/plus buttons and both toggle pills to a single render() function; give the stepper buttons a brief scale(0.92) active-press transform.

special_ui_components.description: A segmented rounded-full Monthly/Annual switch where the active option is a solid amber pill and Annual carries an inline 'SAVE 20%' chip.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build a rounded-full pill group on a charcoal-950/70 track. Two buttons: active = bg-amber + charcoal-950 text + soft shadow; inactive = transparent + stone-400 text. The Annual button additionally renders a small rounded-full charcoal-950 chip reading 'SAVE 20%' in honey (#ffd98a), 700 weight, tracked-wide, 10.5px. Toggling swaps the active class set and triggers the pricing recalculation.

special_ui_components.description: A compact rounded-full minus / count / plus control that sets how many seats the prices are multiplied by.
special_ui_components.prompt: Rounded-full bordered group (border white/10, bg charcoal-950/70). Minus = 32px circle, subtle white/6 fill, hover white/12, thin amber-ish minus glyph; count = centered Sora 700 white, tabular-nums, ~36px wide; plus = 32px solid amber circle with charcoal-950 plus glyph. Both buttons scale to 0.92 on :active. Clicking adjusts the seats state (clamped 1-99) and re-renders all prices/totals.

special_ui_components.description: The middle Studio card is visually elevated to steer choice.
special_ui_components.prompt: Give the featured card an amber/40 border, a subtle top-to-bottom charcoal-800->charcoal-850 gradient, the amber glow ring shadow (0 0 0 1px rgba(240,168,48,0.45), 0 26px 64px -22px rgba(240,168,48,0.40)), a thin amber gradient hairline pinned to its top edge (via-amber, fading to transparent on both ends), and a floating centered 'MOST POPULAR' pill (absolute -top-3, bg-amber, charcoal-950 uppercase tracked text, amber glow). Its CTA is a solid amber button; standard cards use ghost/outline buttons.

structured.special_notes: Frameless, fully responsive web page (no browser chrome / no device frame): content lives in mx-auto max-w-7xl with px-5 -> sm:px-8 padding; the pricing grid reflows 3-col -> 2-col -> 1-col (lg/md/base) and the control bar + testimonial strip + footer all stack vertically on mobile; the nav is sticky and blurred. Built with Tailwind via CDN plus a small tailwind.config that registers the custom 'charcoal' and 'amber' color scales and the Sora/Inter font families; Google Fonts loads Sora + Inter. Icons are inline Phosphor-style SVGs (sparkle, lightning, check, plus, arrow, social) and checkmarks/FAQ pluses are injected once via a small script. All copy and brand ('Promptsmith') are placeholders meant to be swapped; the transferable value is the amber-on-warm-charcoal style and the seat x billing live-pricing structure, not the specific product.
